Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the demo earlier today. Quick recap from our side and a couple of asks so we can finalize the POC scope: 

- Goal: Validate cost-per-request and latency consistency for our customer-facing summarization flow (avg input length ~1k tokens).
- Success criteria (high level): 95th percentile latency < 600ms on standard requests; end-to-end accuracy within 5% of our current baseline for summaries.
- Ideal timeline: 3-week POC (kickoff week of July 6, final readout by July 24).

Next steps from Hyperion: confirm success criteria formally and share any sample data and eval scripts.

I copied Sara Lee (product) — she’ll drive the internal evaluation.

Thanks,
Alex

Alex — great to meet you and thanks for the clear recap. Summary + proposed plan below.

Summary of scope (we heard):
- Primary workload: summarization pipeline (~1k token inputs).
- Metrics: latency (p95) and summary quality (we’ll use your eval script).
- Constraints: GDPR data subset, no external telemetry outside VPC during trial.

Proposed POC plan (Redwood):
1) Kickoff & environment setup (Week 1): access + sample data ingestion, baseline runs.
2) Weekly check-ins (Week 2 & Week 3): cadence to review interim metrics and tweak batching/quantization.
3) Final readout (end of Week 3): throughput/latency report, cost estimate, recommendations.

Deliverables we’ll send before kickoff:
- POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx (attached) — please fill the cells with your pass/fail thresholds.
- redwood-poc-checklist.pdf — ops checklist for data access and eval scripts.

Open items / asks for Hyperion:
- Fill success criteria spreadsheet and return by Thu Jun 1 (edit: Jul 1) so we can lock acceptance criteria.
- Provide sample dataset + eval script (S3 link or secure share).
- Confirm preferred kickoff week (you mentioned week of July 6).

If that works I’ll loop in our engineering lead (Dev) to schedule the environment setup and send a calendar invite.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the kickoff invite once we have confirmed dates and the success criteria doc is back.

Best,
Marissa Cole
